༄༅/ /smar khrid tshom bu lugs bzhugs/oṃ swā sti/'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i man ngag las brtsams nas/yi dam kun gyi smar khrid nyams su blang bar 'do

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /smar khrid tshom bu lugs bzhugs/ oṃ swā sti/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i man ngag las brtsams nas/ yi dam kun gyi smar khrid nyams su blang bar 'dod pas 'di ltar bya ste/ de yang sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes kyi khrid gsum mo/ /dang po ni/ dal 'byor rnyed dka' ba dang*/ 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang*/ 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang*/ las rgyu 'bras bsam pa rnams spyi dang 'dra ste/ skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa sogs gzhan las shes par bya'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro la/ chos spyod thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdig sgrib sbyong ba rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas/ tshogs rdzogs shing byin rlabs 'jug pa maṇḍal/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang bcas pa rnams yin te/ de dag kyang rgyas par zab lam rdo rje'i rnal 'byor gyi sngon 'gro'i khrid yig tu blta bar bya'o/ /bsdu na thun 'go'i skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dang*/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor tsam gyis kyang chog gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bskyed rim dang rdzogs rim gnyis las/ dang po la/ thun gyi sngon 'gro ni/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad la dmigs te/ ci mdzad khyed rang shes so snyam pa'i blos 'gel gyi skyabs 'gro dang*/ mkha' mnyam sems can thams cad la dmigs nas snying rjes kun nas bslangs pa'i sangs rgyas thob 'dod kyi sems bskyed gsal btab ste/ sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la/ /zhes sogs yid ma yengs par mang du brjod/ spyi bor bla ma bsgom/ mos gus dung ba dang bcas pas yig brgya mang du bzlas/ bdag la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ ces gsol ba btab pas/ 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsgom/ cung zad sems ngal gso/ thun gyi dngos gzhi'i rnal 'byor ni/ rnam pa gsum ste/ rang yi dam kun 'dus su bsgom pa/ spyi bor bla ma kun 'dus su bsgom pa/ mkha' khyab bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro/

/dang po ni/ swābhā wa'i sngags lan gsum brjod pas/ snang ba thams cad 'ja' yal ba bzhin du song*/ sems spros bral la cung zad mnyam par bzhag chos nyid stong pa nyid la byang chub pa'o/ /de'i ngang las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor zhig bsam ste/ sku zla ba la byang chub pa'o/ /de'i steng du hrīḥdakar po bsam ste/ gsung yig 'bru la byang chub pa'o/ /de las padma dkar po sdong bu dang bcas pa lte ba la hrīḥs mtshan par gyur pa ni/ thugs phyag mtshan la byang chub pa'o/ /de las 'od 'phraus/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ slar 'dus te thim/ zla bas sa bon phyag mtshan ro gcig tu 'dres pa las bdag nyid 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi skur grub pa ni/ lha sku yongs su rdzogs pa la byang chub pa'o/ /de nas sku mdog dkar po phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba/ g.yon 'og mas padma dkar po/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis pad zla la bzhugs pa/ dar dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa sogs mtshan nyid spyi dang mthun/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od zair 'phros/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'/ rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs zhi khro rab 'byams thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rnam par spyan drangs te rang la thim/ badzra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃḥbaṃ ho zhes brjod/ rang nyid rnam pa ma 'gyur pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs yin la/ ngo bo yang ma gyur pa 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi rang bzhin la/ mtshan nyid khyad par gyi chos yi dam kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo yin snyam du mos pa drag po bya/ de nyid lan gsum sogs bskyar gyin bsgom mo/ /nyams khrid du byed na re zhig de la dmigs skor gcig tu byed do/ /gnyis pa ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar rtsa ba'i bla ma sangs rgyas 'od dpag med kyi rnam par byon/ bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ badzrir bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūṃ/

zhes bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ spyi bo nas rkang mthil gyi bar lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ sdig sgrib dag yon tan thams cad rdzogs/ bla ma 'od dpag med rang gi spyi bor bzhugs/ de'i thugs ka nas 'od 'phros/ dngos su chos 'brel thob pa'i rtsa ba'i bla ma rnams dang*/ dngos su ma mjal yang chos brgyud la bzhugs pa'i brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad spyan drangs te/ rtsa ba'i bla ma 'od dpag med la thim pas/ de nyid bla ma kun 'dus su gyur/ de la mos gdung drag pos rtse gcig tu gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /'di yang dmigs skor gcig go gsum pa ni/ de nas/ oṃ ma ṇi padme hūṃ/ zhes bzlas pa na/ rang yi dam kun 'dus yin pas yi dam thams cad kyi bzlas par gyur la/ rigs bdag bla mas gsungs pas bla ma thams cad kyi bzlas par song*/ rang gi skra nyi khri chig stong*/ ba spu bye ba phrag phyed dang bzhi/ srin bu brgyad khri bzhi stong sogs kyang lha'i ngo bor gnas pas/ de thams cad las yig drug gi sgra re byung*/ mkha' mnyam gyi sems can thams cad lhar gsal ba dang*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas rnams dang*/ sa rdo ri brag rtsi shing nags tshal thams cad las kyang yig drug gi sgra rgyun mi 'chad par 'byung nas/ snang srid thams cad yig drug tu 'u ru ru 'dug par mos te/ ma ṇi gang nus su bzla ba nyid do/ /thun gcig go /de thams cad la thun gyi rjes ni/ lha sku stong pa nyid du sbyangs la cung zad bzhag de ltar bsgoms pa'i dge bas bdag dang sems can thams cad 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob pa'i rgyur gyur cig snyam pas bsngo ba smon lam gdab/ gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ thun gyi sngon 'gro sngar dang 'dra/ lus gnad rkang pa rdo rje'i skyil krung ngam/ de ye nas ma lcogs na sems dpa'i skyil krung bya/ lag pa mnyam gzhag gam/ khu tshur brla bzhag sga tshigs bsrang*/ so mchu rang sar bzhag

lce rkan la sbyar/ dpung pa phyir bkyed/ mig lta stangs cung zad gyen du gtad de/ de rjes rlung ro gsum bsal nas rlung rang sor bzhag sems dus gsum gyi rnam rtog yid byed spros pa thams cad spangs nas/ ma bsgrims ma glod gang yang ma bsam par cham me bzhag bying rmugs dang 'phro rgod byung na/ cung zad bsgrims shing bsgrims 'phro la glod/ thun gyi rjes snga ma dang 'dra ste dmigs skor gcig go /de ltar na sems gnas pa de nyid ngos bzung bral zhing*/ snang cha ma 'gags pa ngos zin par bya ste/ yang dmigs skor gcig go /yang snang ba gang shar thams cad gsal la ngos bzung med par gdod ma nas gnas pas/ dgag sgrub spang blang med pas gang shar de kha'i ngang skyong ba ste/ yang dmigs skor gcig go /rgyas par na sor sdud bsam gtan sogs kyi man ngag kyang 'dir ci rigs pa bstan dgos la/ yang na phyag rgya chen por grags pa sogs lta khrid gzhan dang mthun par ngo sprad kyang rung ngo*/ /mdor bsdu na/ rdzogs rim dmigs skor gsum po nyid la gnad thams cad tshang bas 'di tsam gyis chog shes par yang bya'o/ /des dngos gzhi'i khrid tshar/ gsum pa rjes kyi chos drug ste/ bza' ba zas kyi rnal 'byor/ bgo ba gos kyi rnal 'byor/ 'dug sa gnas khang gi rnal 'byor/ gnyid log 'od gsal gyi rnal 'byor/ 'chi khar sangs rgya ba 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor/ bar dor sangs rgya bar do'i rnal 'byor ro/ /dang po ni/ bza' btung che chung gang la longs spyod kyang*/ oṃ āḥhūṃ/ zhes ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho zad mi shes par gyur/ de nas 'bru gsum kho na mang du brjod la/ phud bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la phul/ bdag nyid lha'i nga rgyal gyis longs spyod do/ /gnyis pa ni de dang 'dra ba las/ gos lha rdzas kyi na bza' dpag tu med par byin gyis rlob/ gsum pa'ang de dang 'dra ba las/ gnas khang ngam 'dug sa gang yin pa de/

gzhal med khang du byin gyis brlabs nas mang por spel ba'o/ /bzhi pa ni/ snying gar yi dam 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sor bzhi tsam pa gsal btab/ spyi bor bla ma 'od dpag med bsgom/ gnyis ka la mos gus dung dung pa spel mar bsgom/ nyal pa'i tshe spyi bo'i bla ma 'od dpag med tshangs bug nas zhugs/ snying ga'i yi dam la thim pa'am/ de'i rigs bdag gi tshul du bzhugs pa gang mos pa zhig bsgoms la/ snying ga'i bla ma yi dam la sems gtad de/ gnyid du 'gro bar byas pas 'od gsal zin par 'gyur ro/ /lnga pa la sbyang ba dang*/ las la sbyar ba gnyis kyi/ dang po ni/ spyi bor bla ma/ snying gar yi dam/ lte bar chos 'byung dkar po'i nang du thig le sngo dmar/ tshangs bug rgya mthong kha bye ba bzhin du skya thal le yangs po zhig bsgom/ rlung ro bsal/ rlung bag tsam bzung bas lte ba'i thig le sngo mar de'i dkyil nas/ thig le dkar ser yungs kar tsam zhig thon hīka ring po brjod cing rlung kha nas phyir bsal bas thig le dkar ser de yang hril li li byung*/ snying kha'i yi dam la bskor ba lan gsum byas te/ tshangs bug nas rgyang ste thon nas bla ma'i thugs kar thim/ de lta bu bskyar gyin lan bdun sogs gang mang bsgom/ de nas 'bebs pa ni/ yar 'phos pa thams cad gcig tu 'dud pa'i ngo bo yungs 'bru lta bu de sngar gyi lam brgyud nas lte ba'i thig le la thim/ de nyid lan mang du byas nas/ thun 'jog pa'i tshe/ bla ma yang 'od du zhu nas thim/ tshangs bug kyang zum par bsams nas dge ba bsngo/ gnyis pa las la sbyar ba ni/ dus la babs pa'i tshe bya ste/ 'bebs pa dang bla ma bstim pa dang sgo 'gegs pa gsum spangs pas gzhan sngar bzhin no/ /drug pa ni snang ba 'di thams cad la bar do yin snyam pa'i 'dun pa drag tu sbyangs/ gnas skabs 'di yar 'gro dang mar 'gro'i sa mtshams chen po yin pas/ nyon mongs pa'i dbang du skad cig kyang mi gtong snyam pa'i zhe bcad drag tu byas nas/

gzugs su snang tshad spyan ras gzigs kyi sku/ sgra grags tshad yi ge drug pa'i sngags/ dgra gnyen chags sdang gi yul sogs bdag gzhan snod bcud snang stong sgyu ma lta bur bsgom/ thun mtshams su yang dran pa'i lcags kyus bzung ste/ sems can mthong tshad yi dam du bsgom/ chags sdang gi yul sogs gang shar thams cad bden med sgyu ma'i rtsis zin par byed pa gal che'o/ /de ltar na smar khrid tshim bu lugs kyi snying po bsdus pa 'di yang rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas smras pa'o// //zhus dag /dge legs 'phel/ /mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/smar khrid tshom bu lugs bzhugs/- PAGE 210 -- PAGE 209 -
